newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul denies report on foreign shareholding change.
newsitem.headline: Seoul denies report on foreign shareholding change.

text.p: The South Korean Finance and Economy Ministry on Tuesday denied newspaper reports that the government planned to raise the ceiling on foreign share ownership in the first half of this year and again in the second half.
The Korea Economic Daily quoted an unnamed source at the ministry as saying the ministry would lift the ceiling twice, instead of an earlier plan to raise it only once.
South Korea has pledged to expand the ceiling to 23 percent this year from the current 20 percent, but no time frame has yet been announced.
"It's not true. The ministry has not yet made any decision in connection with the ceiling," said an official at the ministry's securities systems department.
